opening_message:
Ticket 1: John Rodriguez (employee ID E049) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E049.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: John Rodriguez (E049), Analyst, full-time employee. Requested write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write access (admin requires owning role, which does not apply here). Grant write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E049 (John Rodriguez) is a contractor with basic security training (note in shared memory said full-time; security record takes precedence). Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Basic training => maximum is read. Requested write exceeds maximum, so grant read.
reason: Employee E049 (John Rodriguez) requested write access to Source Code. The Security agent's record indicates John is a contractor with basic security training, which takes precedence over the HR note. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training. Since John has basic training, his maximum access level is read. The requested write exceeds the maximum, so grant the maximum of read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

The employee John Rodriguez (E049) requests write access to Source Code.

HR note says: role Analyst, full_time, recommendation write.
Security note says: role Analyst, employment type contractor, basic security training, recommendation read. Security note says security record takes precedence - contractor with basic training, so maximum is read.

There's a conflict between HR (full_time) and Security (contractor). The security agent says their record takes precedence.

According to the policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- John has basic training, so max is read.

Requested write > max read, so grant read.

I'll submit read.
